$comment: Where a registered Service can actually be reached.
This is not chain state and it is not presented as any. `ServiceRegistry.Service`
stores an operator, a tier, a Settlement Window, a bond account and a registration
time. It stores no URL, deliberately: the chain is the billing rail, not a directory
of hosts. Putting one on chain would mean every Service paid gas to move house, and
would make a dead link a permanent record.
So the directory lives here, published by this project, and the Dashboard labels it
as such. A Service registered on chain but absent from this file is still listed
with its real tools and prices; it is shown without a run command, and the page says
that is why. The chain remains the authority on what a Service charges. This file is
only the authority on where to send the call.
No key material belongs here. Every value below is a public endpoint.

services.name: tab.proof-service
services.summary: Generates an Attestcoin Continuity Proof and Merkle Proof for a Creditcoin block height, which is what a Settlement needs before a contract will accept it.

tools.proof.generate: Returns the proof pair for one height. Priced per call; nothing is paid to make the call.
